purpose: Repair and audit pipeline for LLM outputs before party-state commit.
non_goals: Does not create world content in code.
Does not silently fix semantic contradictions.

pipeline_steps.input: llm_response_raw; step_id; agent_id; prompt_hash; model_metadata; party_id; turn_id nullable
pipeline_steps.hard_gate: Raw result is stored exactly; code does not edit semantic content.
pipeline_steps.on_fail: Abort step with infrastructure_error; no world state writes.

pipeline_steps.hard_gate: Must be valid JSON where JSON is required; required fields must exist; enum values must match.
pipeline_steps.on_fail: Send raw result + schema errors to repair agent.
pipeline_steps.notes: This is structural validation, not semantic invention.

pipeline_steps.hard_gate: Repair cannot add facts, change accepted meaning, or fill unknowns with confident invention.
pipeline_steps.on_fail: Escalate to step retry or human/debug review; no commit.
pipeline_steps.notes: Repair agent is not a new content generator.

pipeline_steps.hard_gate: No unresolved source is silently upgraded; source status is preserved; unverified external facts remain draft/needs_review.
pipeline_steps.on_fail: Return to original/structuring agent with missing source/status list.
pipeline_steps.notes: Prevents bibliography hallucination and status laundering.

pipeline_steps.input: structured_result; established_party_facts; relevant world_base records; project rules; hidden_state allowed
pipeline_steps.hard_gate: Must not contradict year, region, season, authority, routes, position, body, items, ownership, NPC knowledge, hidden layers or character knowledge.
pipeline_steps.on_fail: Return result to responsible content agent with explicit violations; code does not patch meaning.
pipeline_steps.notes: The auditor detects contradictions; repair is another LLM step, not procedural code.

pipeline_steps.hard_gate: Player-facing prose/UI/journal cannot reveal hidden motives, hidden objects, future dates, objective truth of rumors, technical IDs or raw JSON.
pipeline_steps.on_fail: Return to visible-context selector/prose writer; remove hidden content before prose, not after.

pipeline_steps.input: structured_result; target_table_map; party_database_schema; world_base FK snapshot
pipeline_steps.hard_gate: All writes have target tables, IDs, ownership/visibility/status fields, FK references and transaction order.
pipeline_steps.on_fail: Return to structuring agent with exact missing table/field/FK issue.
pipeline_steps.notes: No partial write of world state before commit gate.

pipeline_steps.writes_to: target party tables; party_llm_steps; party_validation_issues resolved
pipeline_steps.hard_gate: Commit only if schema/source/semantic/visibility/write-plan audits pass or allowed warnings are explicitly recorded.
pipeline_steps.on_fail: Rollback transaction; mark step failed; no player-facing state update.
pipeline_steps.notes: This is the only step that changes authoritative party state.

pipeline_steps.actor: code validator + optional LLM auditor for semantic summary
pipeline_steps.hard_gate: Committed state revision must match write plan; visible output references only committed visible state.
pipeline_steps.on_fail: Flag critical_state_mismatch; block next turn until repaired by explicit state repair procedure.
pipeline_steps.player_visible: only final clean scene after pass
pipeline_steps.notes: Protects against stale prose after failed write.

contracts.purpose: Records unmodified model output and metadata before any parse/repair.
Payload sent to repair agent with raw result, schema errors, allowed operation and constraints.
Repaired result plus declaration of changed fields and whether any issue remains unfixable.
LLM audit of contradictions against project rules and party facts.
Audit that visible/prose/UI outputs contain no hidden state leaks.
Audit source usage, unresolved IDs, confidence/status laundering and draft/approved separation.
Checks target tables, write order, FK references and transaction readiness.
Final pass/fail decision for atomic party-state write.
Top-level outcome for a repaired/audited LLM step.

error_codes.meaning: Output is not valid JSON where JSON is required.
Value is outside allowed enum/check list.
Repair filled an unknown with a confident invented fact.
Repair introduced a new NPC, item, route, event, motive or consequence.
Result references a source ID not in source_records.
Draft/unresolved source used as approved or high confidence.
Result contradicts already fixed party fact.
Result contradicts approved world_base record without explicit conflict procedure.
Visible/prose output reveals hidden state or objective truth not known to character.
Player-facing prose contains IDs, raw JSON, DCs, hidden modifiers or internal calculations.
Write plan references missing world_base or party record.
Some required writes would be missing or out of order.
Low confidence/draft material used only as labeled background or draft party note.
Output includes uncertainty correctly marked as rumor/guess/limited knowledge.

validation_rules.rule: Code may parse, validate, store and route errors, but may not create or semantically repair world facts.
If LLM fails, returns invalid data or fails validation, the pipeline must not create hidden placeholders as accepted world facts.
Structuring and repair agents cannot add new events, NPCs, items, routes, motives or consequences.
Hidden data must be removed before prose generation; it is not enough to give prose agent an instruction not to reveal it.
Visible layer must distinguish character knowledge, rumor, uncertainty and hidden facts.
A record source status cannot be upgraded during repair or import; unresolved sources remain needs_review.

Audits must check year, region, season, authority, law, roles, events, items, routes, map, position, memory, knowledge, NPC knowledge, hidden layers, visible scene, property, access, body and tensions.
No authoritative party-state write occurs until schema, source, semantic, visibility and DB-write audits pass.
Repair loops must have fixed attempt limits; repeated failure escalates instead of infinite auto-editing.
Each LLM step records raw result, repair attempts, validation issues, audit reports and final commit decision.

db_writes.required_fields: party_id, step_id, agent_id, prompt_hash, raw_response, status=raw_captured

db_writes.notes: Parsed payload is not committed to world state yet.

db_writes.required_fields: issue_code, severity, layer=schema, payload_path, message, repairable

db_writes.notes: Unresolved source is not accepted as approved.
LLM auditor output remains diagnostic until repaired.
No commit if any blocking issue remains.

db_writes.required_fields: all validated writes from result contract
db_writes.notes: Only point at which authoritative party state changes.
Protects against stale prose and partial state.

prompts.task: Fix invalid JSON/format/field separation without adding facts.
Audit result against project rules, world_base and party facts.
Check source IDs, statuses, confidence and unresolved records.
Detect hidden-state leaks in visible context, prose, UI or journal.
Turn accepted content into a DB write plan without adding facts.
Make final pass/fail decision from all audit reports.
